text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm back in form, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That should be enough to make up for<n>my
embarrassment at the exhibition<n>race.
choice_data_list: That really got to you, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I may not look it, but I have<n>quite the
competitive streak.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to appear calm and collected in<n>the eyes of
the world, so I make an<n>effort not to let it show.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But when I'm with you... Well,<n>there's no harm in
letting one person<n>see the real me, is there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. What race do you<n>think would
make the best stage for<n>the revived Emperor to
reinforce her<n>dominance?
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fine choice. Equal in prestige to the<n>Big Eight, it
holds the additional<n>distinction of serving as an
international invitational.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Its trophy will make a perfect jewel<n>for the
Emperor's crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled. The Japan Cup it is!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On our way back from the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hear that there's an excellent<n>teahouse just
ahead. Do you know it,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My subordinates in the student<n>council told me
that I had to go if I<n>ever visited Kyoto. What do you
say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that was a little unclear... I'm<n>asking if
you want to join me on a<n>little diversion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Is it really such a shock?
choice_data_list: What about your student council work?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. I usually head straight to the<n>office after
races, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, the student council is as hectic<n>as ever, but
recently I have carved<n>myself out a little breathing
room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is to say, I have revised our<n>workflow. I still
have final say on all<n>decisions, but I've stepped
back<n>somewhat from the direct labor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I have offloaded some<n>responsibility onto
the other members<n>and turned the process into a
more<n>collaborative effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the past, I tried to do everythingmyself, for better and for worse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But now, I guide the other members<n>as they strive
in their own ways to<n>realize our collective dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In many ways, it is more taxing than<n>before, both
mentally and physically.<n>Looking after them will no
doubt still<n>strain my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But I cannot bring about a world of<n>bliss on my
own. The world is built by<n>everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Therefore, everyone has to do their<n>part.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like leaning on others has<n>reduced
Symboli Rudolf's own<n>burden. She seems a lot
less<n>stressed today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that's enough about that. I'm<n>itching to try this
tea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've heard it's tea-riffic! ...What do<n>you think?
Was that good?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You seem awfully prickly today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us pay a visit to the<n>teahouse and
enjoy a tea-riff... um, a<n>delightful time in each
other's<n>company.
